## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title uses Conventional Commits (for example `fix: keep the query string on box requests`).
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Docs are updated (README.md, docs/, `--help` texts) when a setting or behavior changes.
- [ ] The diff has no keys, hostnames, IP addresses or other private data.
- [ ] No new dependencies (or an issue agreed on one first).
- [ ] I read and understand the whole diff, including any AI-assisted parts.
